lead_headline: Weekend restaurant tracker adds 5 leads: Snarf's Sandwiches hits Montbello, Neo Latin Cuisine builds out Colfax, SOL Mexican Cocina confirms Cherry Creek closure after 10-year run.

restaurant.blurb: 5 leads since Friday — Openings: Snarf's Sandwiches (Montbello), Neo Latin Cuisine under construction (Cheesman Park). Closures: SOL Mexican Cocina (Cherry Creek, 10-year run), Little India Downtown (CBD, fire damage), Quad Side Tavern reclassified.

liquor.blurb: Zero applications filed over the weekend — Sunday-Monday blackout follows Wednesday's single-permit filing (The Coastal Service, hotel/restaurant, 8125 E Belleview). Seven-day window holds at 11 total applications, all filed Monday-Wednesday this week after prior week's complete drought. No status changes, no new delinquencies, no clearances since Thursday's activity. Pace now averaging 1.6 permits/day across active filing days vs. typical 8-12 daily baseline — suggests continued industry hesitation or seasonal August slowdown compressing new license activity into concentrated weekday bursts rather than steady flow.

subscriptions.blurb: Net −20 on Wednesday (2 new, 22 canceled) — single-day hemorrhage driven by 22-subscriber exodus drops MTD to −16 (−1.8/day), though 90-day net still holds at +71. Wednesday's mass cancellation event marks worst single-day performance in recent tracking window, erasing prior week's cumulative gains in one session. Seven-day window now shows −15 net (24 new, 39 canceled) vs. prior week's +19 — reversal driven by 160% churn spike (39 vs. 15 canceled) rather than acquisition collapse. Recent pattern shows volatility clustering around mid-week: strong acquisition days (July 28: +10 new, July 31: +7 new) now overwhelmed by Wednesday's catastrophic 22-cancel event. Current −1.8/day MTD pace runs inverse to +0.9/day YTD baseline — August needs immediate +3-4 daily performance through month-end to avoid first negative monthly close in tracking history.
